content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Three years' graduate degree in relevant subject/field + three years' experience OR PG in relevant subject/field. The three years' experience is required with the graduate degree route; the notice does not attach an experience requirement to the PG route. NET/GATE/CSIR/UGC qualified and research experience in the related field will be preferred. Good knowledge about antimicrobials and antimicrobial stewardship activities will be given preference. Knowledge and experience of REDCap usage will be given preference. The age limit is 35 years on the last date of submission (7 November 2026). Age, education qualification and experience will be considered till the last date of submission of the application form. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries monthly emoluments of Rs.34,692 per month (consolidated). The tenure of the post is till May 2027. The appointment is purely on contract basis (temporary in nature) and will not vest any right to claim regular appointment or permanent absorption in GMCH-32 or continued contractual appointment. Leave shall be as per the Institutional Policy for Project staff, at the discretion of the PI.

content_sections.heading: GMCH-32 Project Technical Support-III Job Description
content_sections.text: Work on antimicrobial prescriptions and follow up of patients. Data collection of surgical patients (both emergency and elective procedures). Follow-up of patients for surgical site infections. Contact with health care professionals (surgical team) for follow-up. He/She may have to work in emergency situations, field visits and travel outstation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMCH-32 Project Technical Support-III
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form in the prescribed format attached to the notice (post applied for, personal details, education, post-qualification work experience, and experience with REDCap – Yes or No), and sign the declaration. Attach self-attested hardcopies of the certificates listed below. In-service candidates must attach a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer, failing which the application is liable for rejection. Make sure the application reaches the Department of General Surgery, Level-3rd, Block-D, GMCH-32, Chandigarh on or before 07.11.2026 up to 01:00 pm. Failing this, the application will not be considered. The notice does not mention whether the application should be sent by post or delivered by hand; it only says it must reach the office by the deadline. Brief Curriculum Vitae (in the application form attached) Date of birth certificate Essential qualification certificates Experience certificate NOC, if applicable One passport-size photograph Originals are to be produced during the interview for verification.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: For Project Technical Support-III, a merit list will be made on the basis of qualification merit and working experience. The date of interview will be intimated on the website within 7 working days from the last date of receiving the application; personal phone calls to the office or PI would not be entertained. No TA/DA will be paid for the interview. Mere fulfilling the essential/desired qualification does not guarantee selection, and the decision of the competent authority regarding selection will be final, with no representation entertained.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GMCH-32 Recruitment 2026 for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: There is 01 (One) post of Project Technical Support-III in the Department of General Surgery, GMCH-32, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Department of General Surgery, Level-3rd, Block-D, GMCH-32, Chandigarh on or before 7 November 2026 up to 01:00 pm.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: A three years' graduate degree in relevant subject/field + three years' experience, OR a PG in relevant subject/field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years on the last date of submission, 7 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Project Technical Support-III at GMCH-32?
faq.answer: The post pays Rs.34,692 per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed application form and send it with self-attested hardcopies of certificates so that it reaches the Department of General Surgery, Level-3rd, Block-D, GMCH-32, Chandigarh by 01:00 pm on 7 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How will the candidate be selected?
faq.answer: A merit list will be made on the basis of qualification merit and working experience, and the interview date will be intimated on the website within 7 working days from the last date of receiving applications.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely on contract basis (temporary in nature), with tenure till May 2027, and gives no right to regular appointment or permanent absorption in GMCH-32.

faq.question: Q9. Do in-service candidates need an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes. In-service candidates must submit a No Objection Certificate from the present employer, failing which the application is liable for rejection.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for the interview.
